HADESANCIENTS-HANGOVER_POWER.title: Hangover
HADESANCIENTS-HANGOVER_POWER.description: Hungover creatures take damage at the end of their turn. Each turn, [gold]Hangover[/gold] is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
HADESANCIENTS-HANGOVER_POWER.smartDescri: At the end of {OnPlayer:your turn, take|its turn, takes} [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage, then reduce [gold]Hangover[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue].
